item.title: As Hezbollah rejects truce, families on Israel's northern border describe life under fire
item.description: Residents of Israel's northern border describe life under what they call "the ceasefire war," with sirens and explosions despite agreements.

item.title: Canada's Carney pledges action on antisemitism amid backlash over new anti-hate council members
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney's new council to combat antisemitism draws backlash over members critics say are hostile to Israel and Jewish concerns.

item.title: Israel's military eliminates Hamas terrorist who helped abduct American-Israeli hostage, 3 others
item.description: The IDF announced it killed a Hamas Nukhba terrorist who participated in the abduction of hostage Hersh Goldberg-Polin during the Oct. 7 attack.

item.title: Pete Hegseth warns narco-terrorists as US backs Bolivia's government amid coup warnings
item.description: War Secretary Pete Hegseth says the U.S. remains committed to defending Bolivia's government amid coup warnings and mass unrest over fuel prices.

item.title: Sherpa missing for a week on Everest found crawling toward base camp after his family begins funeral rites
item.description: Rescuers call it a miracle after a Sherpa guide survived nearly a week alone on Mount Everest without food, water or supplemental oxygen in the death zone.

item.title: US ally Kuwait condemns 'brutal and ongoing Iranian attacks' after airport was hit
item.description: Kuwait has condemned "the brutal and ongoing Iranian attacks using ballistic missiles and drones," saying Kuwait International Airport had been targeted.

item.title: Israeli official says EU sanctions reveal antisemitism hiding behind 'socially acceptable mask'
item.description: Israel's Deputy Foreign Minister accuses the EU of disguising antisemitism as anti-Zionism after sanctions hit Israeli civil society organizations.

item.title: Hezbollah's 'game changing' night-hunting weapon punches through Israel's defenses: expert
item.description: Drone expert warns Hezbollah's nighttime drone capabilities are game changing, using thermal sensors to target IDF troops under cover of darkness.

item.title: Iranians speak out over possible Trump-regime deal
item.description: Iranians inside Iran express fear and frustration that a potential U.S.-Iran deal could leave the Islamic Republic intact despite economic devastation.

item.title: US ally answers Trump's call on Strait of Hormuz: 'Part of a diplomatic effort'
item.description: Romania allowed access to military bases for air refueling and defensive activities amid U.S.-Iran tensions, its foreign minister tells Fox News Digital.
